overview: Black checks early with the bishop and plans to exchange it on d2, then play ...b6 and ...Bb7 with a flexible Indian-style set-up. White gets space with e4 and Nc3 and the game becomes a manoeuvring one in which Black tries to attack the centre from the wings. It is sound but passive and rare at strong level.

white_ideas.idea: Meet ...Bxd2+ with Qxd2 and play Nc3 and e4 to build a big centre.
Develop with Nf3 and g3 and fight for the long diagonal against ...Bb7.

black_ideas.idea: Trade the bishop on d2, then fianchetto the other bishop to b7 and play against the centre.
Provoke weaknesses with ...a5 and ...Bxd2+ and aim for a Queen's Indian-like game.

typical_structures.structure: White e4/d4/c4 centre against Black e6/b6 with a bishop on b7.

character.notes: Passive but sound; Black exchanges the bishop and waits.

structure.notes: White builds a big centre against Black's flank play, so the centre is flexible at first.

level.notes: Simple plans but gives White an easy edge.

sublines_that_differ.name: Kangaroo Variation
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. d4 e6 2. c4 Bb4+ 3. Bd2 Bxd2+ 4. Qxd2 b6 5. Nc3 Bb7 6. e4 Nh6
sublines_that_differ.how: Black develops the knight to h6 for ...f5, a dubious attempt.

level.reason: Simple ideas but not a first repertoire.

plans.reason: White gains space while Black fianchettoes.
